sentences.en: George Hummel of Sogerties, New York, visited the Poor House Cemetery with his wife.
sentences.zh: 来自纽约州索格蒂斯的乔治·胡梅尔和他的妻子参观了贫民窟墓地。

sentences.en: They were convinced the woman in the barrel was their daughter, Annie Hummel.
sentences.zh: 他们坚信木桶里的女子就是他们的女儿安妮·胡梅尔。

sentences.en: After hearing the Hummel's story, Coroner Dempsey ordered the woman's body to be exhumed once again.
sentences.zh: 听完胡梅尔一家的故事后，登普西验尸官下令再次将女尸掘出。

sentences.en: It was starting to become a common occurrence.
sentences.zh: 这开始变成了一件常见的事。

sentences.en: George Hummel explained that the year prior, 1877, at the age of 13, his daughter Annie went to work in the home of a wealthy couple in
sentences.zh: 乔治·胡梅尔解释说，前一年（1877年），在他女儿安妮13岁时，她去索格蒂斯一户

sentences.en: Sogerties.
sentences.zh: 富裕人家的家里做帮工。

sentences.en: The wife fell ill and was moved to New York City for treatment.
sentences.zh: 女主人病倒了，被转移到纽约市接受治疗。

sentences.en: With his wife out of the house, the husband made advances on Annie, and by the end of that year, had got her pregnant.
sentences.zh: 趁着妻子不在家，男主人对安妮展开了追求，并在那年年底让她怀了孕。

sentences.en: Without the knowledge of Annie's parents, the husband said Annie was suffering with dropsy, and sent her to New York City for treatment too.
sentences.zh: 在安妮父母不知情的情况下，男主人谎称安妮患了水肿，也将她送到纽约市接受治疗。

sentences.en: Annie was never seen again, and when Annie's parents heard about the mysterious woman in the barrel, they were convinced it was her.
sentences.zh: 此后再也没人见过安妮，当安妮的父母听到关于木桶中神秘女子的消息时，他们坚信那就是她。

sentences.en: Dr. Welzer had initially determined the woman was aged 25 to 30, but that determination was far from an exact science in 1878.
sentences.zh: 韦尔策医生最初判定该女子的年龄在25到30岁之间，但在1878年，这种判定远非一门精确的科学。

sentences.en: Coroner Dempsey was open to the possibility that the body could be 13-year-old Annie Hummel.
sentences.zh: 登普西验尸官对这具尸体可能是13岁安妮·胡梅尔的可能性持开放态度。

sentences.en: Once again, the little that remained of the woman's body was dug up from the earth.
sentences.zh: 女尸仅存的残骸再次被从泥土中挖了出来。

sentences.en: Upon his first glimpse of the braid of hair, George Hummel exclaimed it was Annie, and he and his wife broke down.
sentences.zh: 乔治·胡梅尔刚瞥了一眼那条发辫，就失声大喊那就是安妮，他和妻子顿时痛哭失声。

sentences.en: The coroner considered it might have been
sentences.zh: 验尸官认为这有可能是

sentences.zh: 安妮·胡梅尔，但实际上根本无法确定，因为现在已经出现了两个完全不同且都言之凿凿的身份辨认结果。

sentences.en: So who was right?

sentences.zh: 不久之后，

sentences.en: Coroner Dempsey received a letter from Annie Hummel's childhood physician.
sentences.zh: 邓普西验尸官收到了一封来自安妮·胡梅尔儿时医生的信。

sentences.en: The letter stated that Annie had suffered a fracture to the wrist of her right arm at seven years of age.
sentences.zh: 信中提到，安妮在七岁时右手手腕曾受过骨折。

sentences.en: If the right arm bone of the corpse was able to show evidence of the fracture, there would be no doubt it was Annie, and the mystery would be solved.
sentences.zh: 如果尸体的右臂骨骼能显示出骨折的痕迹，那就毫无疑问她就是安妮，谜团也将随之解开。

sentences.en: Coroner Dempsey agreed to exhume the body again.
sentences.zh: 邓普西验尸官同意再次掘棺验尸。

sentences.en: George Hummel, his attorney, and Annie's childhood physician were in attendance.
sentences.zh: 乔治·胡梅尔、他的律师以及安妮儿时的主治医生都在现场。

sentences.en: It took the gravediggers about half an hour to bring the coffin to the surface.
sentences.zh: 掘墓人们花了大约半小时才把棺材运到地面上。

sentences.en: They roughly removed it from the deep pit and loosened to the top with a hatchet.
sentences.zh: 他们粗暴地将棺材从深坑中抬出，并用短斧撬开了棺材盖。

sentences.en: There was only one way to check if there was a fracture in 1878.
sentences.zh: 在1878年，要核实是否存在骨折只有一种方法。

sentences.zh: 一名墓地员工开始煮手臂以剥离血肉。

sentences.zh: 完工后，他将手臂交给了医生。

sentences.en: There was no sign of a fracture.
sentences.zh: 没有任何骨折的迹象。

sentences.zh: 一个在木桶里的女人被发现11天后看到过什么的人。《纽约时报》刊登了一篇关于陷入僵局的调查的报道。

sentences.zh: 除了埃伦·墨菲和安妮·胡梅尔的故事之外。

sentences.zh: 这位验尸官目前手里还有将近一打信件，来自那些年轻女性的朋友，这些女性在类似情况下离家出走，至今下落不明。

sentences.zh: 当地一位记者触及了这一令人痛心的现状。

sentences.zh: 引文：

sentences.en: At the end of September, two weeks after the woman in the barrel was found, a local man named August Keemer came forward.
sentences.zh: 九月底，也就是木桶女尸被发现两周后，当地一名叫奥古斯特·基默的男子站了出来。

sentences.en: He told police that he saw a man in the woods near Silver Lake, Staten Island, on July 20th, 1878.
sentences.zh: 他告诉警察，1878年7月20日，他在斯塔滕岛银湖附近的树林里看到了一个男人。

sentences.en: The man he saw was pushing a wheelbarrow, with a barrel in it.
sentences.zh: 他看到的那个男人推着一辆独轮车，车里装着一个木桶。

sentences.en: The man that August saw was Edward Reinhardt.
sentences.zh: 奥古斯特看到的那个男人是爱德华·莱恩哈特。

sentences.en: August pointed Reinhardt out to police after he heard about the woman in the barrel, but they didn't follow it up.
sentences.zh: 奥古斯特在听说木桶女尸的事后向警方指认了莱恩哈特，但警方并没有跟进调查。

sentences.en: Reinhardt lived on Broome Street, Lower Manhattan, with his new wife, Pauline Dittmar.
sentences.zh: 莱恩哈特和他的新婚妻子波琳·迪特马尔住在曼哈顿下城的布鲁姆街。

sentences.en: They had been married since July.
sentences.zh: 他们从七月份开始就结婚了。

sentences.en: After getting nothing from the police, August Kima approached Coroner Dempsey and told him what he saw.
sentences.zh: 在警察那里毫无收获后，奥古斯特·基马找到了邓普西验尸官，并将他所看到的一切告诉了对方。

sentences.en: Coroner Dempsey was hopeful that he had finally found a witness.
sentences.zh: 邓普西验尸官燃起希望，觉得他终于找到了一个目击者。

sentences.en: On October 3rd 1878
Dempsey and August visited Reinhardt's house so August could make a formal identification that
sentences.zh: 邓普西和奥古斯特拜访了莱恩哈特的住所，以便奥古斯特进行正式辨认，确认

sentences.en: Reinhardt was the man he saw with a barrel at Silver Lake, Staten Island.
sentences.zh: 莱恩哈特就是他在斯塔滕岛银湖看到带着木桶的那个男人。

sentences.en: Reinhardt let them inside and acknowledged that he had lived on Staten Island until July.
sentences.zh: 莱恩哈特让他们进了屋，并承认自己在7月之前一直住在斯塔滕岛。

sentences.en: He had run a candy store on Gore Street, now Broad Street, in Stapleton.
sentences.zh: 他曾在斯塔普尔顿的戈尔街（现为百老汇）经营一家糖果店。

sentences.en: But he moved to Lower Manhattan when he married his wife Pauline in July.
sentences.zh: 但在7月与妻子波琳结婚后，他搬到了曼哈顿下城。

sentences.en: Coroner Dempsey was direct and asked Reinhardt whether he had buried a barrel at Silver Lake.
sentences.zh: 邓普西验尸官开门见山，质问莱恩哈特是否在银湖埋过一个木桶。

sentences.en: Reinhardt emphatically denied it.
sentences.zh: 莱恩哈特坚决予以否认。

sentences.en: He said the only barrel he moved around that time was the day he moved out of the candy store, July 20th.
sentences.zh: 他说那段时间他搬动过的唯一一个木桶，就是7月20日他搬出糖果店那天的事。

sentences.en: He moved a barrel full of crockery in a wheelbarrow to his sister's house.
sentences.zh: 他用独轮车运了一桶满满的陶器到他姐姐家。

sentences.en: After further questioning,
sentences.zh: 经过进一步盘问，

sentences.en: Coroner Dempsey learned that Reinhardt was in a relationship with a woman named Marianne Keegan before he met his wife Pauline.
sentences.zh: 邓普西验尸官得知莱恩哈特在结识妻子波琳之前，曾与一个名叫玛丽安·基甘的女子交往过。

sentences.en: Reinhardt said he was still in touch with Marianne and he gave the coroner addresses for where she might be, but when the coroner went to find her,
sentences.zh: 莱恩哈特说他和玛丽安仍有联系，并给验尸官留下了她可能所在地址，但当验尸官去找她时，

sentences.en: there was no trace of anyone by that name.
sentences.zh: 根本找不到任何叫这个名字的人的踪迹。

sentences.en: The coroner returned and arrested Reinhardt on suspicion of complicity.
sentences.zh: 验尸官返回并以涉嫌共犯的罪名逮捕了莱恩哈特。

sentences.en: Reinhardt was told he would be appearing at the inquest's next jury sitting, and was transported back to Staten Island.
sentences.zh: 莱恩哈特被告知他将出席下一次的陪审团听证会，并被押送回斯塔滕岛。

sentences.en: Reinhardt's wife, Pauline Didmar, was shocked by her husband's arrest, and wondered what was going on.
sentences.zh: 莱恩哈特的妻子波琳·迪德马尔对丈夫被捕感到震惊，不知发生了什么事。

sentences.en: Pauline had met Reinhardt at his mother's house earlier that year in Newark, New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 波琳是今年早些时候在新泽西州纽瓦克莱恩哈特的母亲家里认识他的。

sentences.en: Living nearby, Pauline had got to know his mother quite well.
sentences.zh: 由于住在附近，波琳对他的母亲相当熟悉。

sentences.en: She enjoyed Reinhardt's company, and accepted his offer to take her to a ball.
sentences.zh: 她很享受与莱恩哈特在一起的时光，并接受了他邀请她去参加舞会的提议。

sentences.en: Reinhardt didn't speak of previous relationships and Pauline didn't ask.
sentences.zh: 莱恩哈特没有谈及过往的感情经历，波琳也没有追问。

sentences.en: When he asked her to marry him, Pauline didn't hesitate.
sentences.zh: 当他向她求婚时，波琳没有丝毫犹豫。

sentences.en: They married on July 13, 1878 and moved straight into Broom Street, Lower Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 他们在1878年7月13日结婚，并直接搬进了曼哈顿下城的布鲁姆街。

sentences.en: The week after their marriage, Reinhardt told
sentences.zh: 结婚后的一周，莱恩哈特告诉

sentences.en: Pauline he needed to go and settle some things back on Staten Island.
sentences.zh: 波琳他需要回斯塔滕岛去处理一些事情。

sentences.en: Pauline went to visit him on Staten Island later that week, but she couldn't locate him.
sentences.zh: 波琳那周晚些时候去斯塔滕岛看望他，但怎么也找不到他。

sentences.en: A few days after Reinhardt's arrest,
sentences.zh: 莱恩哈特被捕几天后，

sentences.en: Pauline was visited by Coroner Dempsey and two police officers.
sentences.zh: 邓普西验尸官和两名警官造访了波琳。

sentences.en: Another family had come forward to Coroner Dempsey and claimed that the woman in the barrel was their daughter, Mary Ann Degnan.
sentences.zh: 另一家人向邓普西验尸官现身，声称木桶里的女人是他们的女儿玛丽·安·德格南。

sentences.en: Mary Ann Degnan had been missing since July.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·安·德格南自七月起就失踪了。

sentences.en: What caught Dempsey's attention immediately was the name, Mary Ann Degnan.
sentences.zh: 最引起邓普西注意的是这个名字：玛丽·安·德格南。

sentences.en: Reinhardt had told Dempsey that before his marriage to Pauline, he was seeing a woman named Mary Ann Keegan.
sentences.zh: 莱恩哈特曾告诉邓普西，在与波琳结婚之前，他一直在和一个叫玛丽·安·基甘的女人交往。

sentences.en: Dempsey's senses were on high alert.

sentences.en: It was also discovered that Pauline
sentences.zh: 人们还发现宝琳·

sentences.en: Reinhardt had been climbing up on a barrel outside Edward Reinhardt's cell window, and they were able to engage in whispered conversations without detection.
sentences.zh: 莱恩哈特曾爬上爱德华·莱恩哈特牢房窗外的木桶，他们得以在不被发觉的情况下进行低声交谈。

sentences.en: Reinhardt was put on extra watch.
sentences.zh: 莱恩哈特受到了特别看守。

sentences.en: In May 1879, the case was presented to a grand jury.
sentences.zh: 1879年5月，该案被提交给大陪审团。

sentences.en: Edward Reinhardt was represented by defence lawyer William Howe, who had defended other accused murderers in many a sensational trial at the time.
sentences.zh: 爱德华·莱恩哈特的辩护律师是威廉·豪，他曾在许多轰动的审判中为其他被控谋杀的人辩护过。

sentences.en: The jury were advised by the judge to decide whether Mary Ann's death was of natural causes during childbirth, or if she was killed at the hands of her husband.
sentences.zh: 法官建议陪审团决定玛丽·安的死是分娩时的自然原因，还是被她丈夫杀害。

sentences.en: Edward Reinhart changed his story at the criminal trial.
sentences.zh: 爱德华·莱恩哈特在刑事审判中改变了他的说法。

sentences.en: He claimed that on July 18, he had put Mary Ann
sentences.zh: 他声称，在7月18日，他把玛丽·安·

sentences.en: Reinhart on a morning ferry to Manhattan to visit an unnamed doctor to obtain medicine in order to abort her baby.
sentences.zh: 莱恩哈特送上了去曼哈顿的早班渡轮，去拜访一位不知名的医生以获取打胎的药物。

sentences.en: Mary Ann returned that evening.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·安当晚回来了。

sentences.en: The following day, Edward Reinhart said Mary Ann fell ill with terrible stomach pains after taking the medicine.
sentences.zh: 第二天，爱德华·莱恩哈特说玛丽·安在服药后开始胃痛得厉害。

sentences.en: He said she'd died between 11pm and midnight that night.
sentences.zh: 他说她在当晚11点到午夜之间去世了。

sentences.en: Reinhart claimed that he panicked and thought he would be held responsible for her death and possibly charged with criminal malpractice, so he tried to hide her by burying
sentences.zh: 莱恩哈特声称他当时惊慌失措，认为自己会被追究死因责任，并可能被指控医疗事故犯罪，于是他试图通过将她埋在银湖树林里来藏匿尸体。

sentences.en: her in the woods at Silver Lake.
sentences.zh: 她说他把她带到银湖时，她的头骨骨折了。

sentences.en: He said the fracture on her skull occurred when he was taking her to Silver Lake.
sentences.zh: 据他所说，她从木桶上摔下来，头部撞到了一块石头上。

sentences.en: According to him, she fell from the barrel and her head struck a rock.
sentences.zh: 听取了所有证据后，法官向陪审团提出了以下问题。

sentences.en: When all of the evidence was heard, the judge proposed the following questions to the jury.
sentences.zh: 莱恩哈特是否对另一个女人倾注了爱意？

sentences.en: Had Reinhardt bestowed his affections on another woman?
sentences.zh: 他是否同时应付两个妻子，是否有动机摆脱第一个妻子？

sentences.en: Did he have two wives on his hands, and was there motive to rid himself of the first?
sentences.zh: 他的困境是犯罪的动机吗？

sentences.en: Was his predicament motive for the crime?
sentences.zh: 摆脱第一任妻子是否符合他的愿望？你们陪审团来决定。

sentences.en: was it desirable on his part to get rid of his first wife you the jury shall decide the jury
sentences.zh: 陪审团在上午9点30分退席，仅用了40分钟就达成了一项裁决。

sentences.en: retired at 9 30 a.m and took just 40 minutes to reach a verdict reinhart was brought back into
sentences.zh: 莱恩哈特被带回法庭，走过排成一列面向栅栏和法官的陪审团成员身边。

sentences.en: the court and passed the line of jurors who were all standing in a single line facing the bar and
sentences.zh: 他们40分钟前坐过的椅子现在被另一个准备审理另一个案件的陪审团小组占据了。

sentences.en: the judge the chairs they had sat on just 40 minutes prior were now occupied by another jury panel ready to sit on another case.
sentences.zh: 县书记官点名了陪审团成员，每个人都一一应答了自己的名字。

sentences.en: The county clerk called a roll call of the jurors and each answered individually to their name.
sentences.zh: 爱德华·莱恩哈特被要求在陪审团面前起立。

sentences.en: Edward Reinhardt was asked to rise before the jury.
sentences.zh: 他被要求看着他们，而他们看着他。

sentences.en: He was asked to look upon them and they upon him.
sentences.zh: 许多陪审团成员感到挣扎，把目光朝下。

sentences.en: Many jurors struggled and kept their eyes facing down.
sentences.zh: 书记官说，先生们你们怎么说，被告席上的囚犯对起诉书中所控的谋杀罪行是有罪还是无罪。

sentences.en: The clerk said, how say you gentlemen, is the prisoner at the bar guilty or not guilty of the crime of murder charged in the indictment.
sentences.zh: 有一段痛苦的停顿，因为没有一个陪审团成员知道谁被选为陪审团长。

sentences.en: There was a painful pause as no jury member knew who had been elected foreman.
sentences.zh: 在终于有人开口之前，他们都尴尬地互相看着。

sentences.en: They all looked to one another uncomfortably before someone finally spoke up.
sentences.zh: 我们裁定他一级谋杀罪名成立。

sentences.en: We find him guilty of murder in the first degree.
sentences.zh: 裁决是全票通过的。

sentences.en: The verdict was unanimous.
sentences.zh: 地方检察官要求立即宣判。

sentences.en: The district attorney called for immediate sentencing.
sentences.zh: 法官指示瘫坐在椅子上的莱恩哈特站到他面前。

sentences.en: The judge directed Reinhardt, who had fallen in his chair to stand before him.
sentences.zh: 他问他是否有理由不应该在今天宣判。

sentences.en: He asked him if he had any reason why sentencing should not be passed that day.
sentences.zh: 莱恩哈特站着，扶着他的椅子。

sentences.en: Reinhardt stood holding his chair.
sentences.zh: 他三次试图开口说话，但什么也没说出来。

sentences.en: Three times he went to speak, but nothing came out.
sentences.zh: 当他终于能说话时，他继续了一场关于自己无罪的长篇大论。

sentences.en: When he finally was able to speak, he continued a long monologue of his innocence.
sentences.zh: 法官没有打断他，让他说下去。

sentences.en: The judge let him speak with no interruption.
sentences.zh: 整个法庭除了爱德华·莱恩哈特单调的话语外，一片死寂。

sentences.en: The entire court was completely silent except for the monotone words of Edward Reinhart.
sentences.zh: 在他的演讲结束后，法官没有犹豫哪怕一秒钟就宣判了。

sentences.en: At the conclusion of his speech, the judge didn't hesitate for a single second before delivering his sentence.
sentences.zh: 你将于今年7月11日被绞死，

sentences.en: You will be hanged on July 11 this year,
sentences.zh: 1879年，在九点到两点之间。

sentences.en: 1879, between nine and two o'clock.
sentences.zh: 当莱恩哈特被带回牢房时，他呼唤他的妻子宝琳，但她拒绝去见他。

sentences.en: When Reinhart was taken down to the jail cell, he called for his wife Pauline, but she refused to go to him.
sentences.zh: 在她被发现在银湖并被埋在无名坟墓里的一年半之后，

sentences.en: A year and a half after her body was found at Silver Lake and buried in an unmarked grave.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·安的家人终于能够让她在布鲁克林的圣十字公墓安息。

sentences.en: Mary Ann's family were able to finally lay her to rest in peace at the Holy Cross Cemetery in Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，当法官批准了一份令状和暂缓诉讼程序时，爱德华·莱恩哈特幸运了。

sentences.en: In the meantime, Edward Reinhardt got lucky when the judge granted a writ of error and a stay of proceedings.
sentences.zh: 案件将上诉至上诉法院。

sentences.en: The case would go to the Court of Appeals.
sentences.zh: 暂缓执行一直拖到1880年12月，当时莱恩哈特面临他的最后一次上诉。

sentences.en: The stays dragged on until December 1880, when Reinhardt faced his last appeal.
sentences.zh: 上诉法院维持了他的定罪，他再次被判处绞刑。

sentences.en: The Court of Appeals sustained his conviction, and he was again sentenced to death by hanging.
sentences.zh: 他的死刑被命令于1881年1月14日执行。

sentences.en: His execution was ordered to take place on January 14, 1881.
sentences.zh: 正当里士满县满怀期待地等待莱恩哈特的处决时，监狱准备好了绞刑架。

sentences.en: As Richmond County waited with anticipation for Reinhart's execution, the prison prepared the gallows.
sentences.zh: 绞刑架是用于绞刑处决的木制脚手架或框架。

sentences.en: The gallows were the wooden scaffolding or frame used for execution by hanging.
sentences.zh: 这些绞刑架是在监狱院子东侧一个专门建造的30平方英尺的围栏内搭建的。

sentences.en: These gallows were erected in a purpose-built 30-square-foot enclosure on the eastern side of the jail yard.
sentences.zh: 绞刑不对公众开放。

sentences.en: The hanging was closed to the general public.
sentences.zh: 只有持票者才被获准进入观看了。

sentences.en: Only ticket holders were granted access to view it.
sentences.zh: 1881年1月14日，26岁的爱德华·莱恩哈特迎来了他的最后一天。

sentences.en: On January 14, 1881, 26-year-old Edward Reinhardt faced his final day.
sentences.zh: 这一天成为了整个斯塔滕岛大肆庆祝的来源。

sentences.en: The day became a source of huge celebration across Staten Island.
sentences.zh: 全岛的小酒馆从清晨就开始庆祝。

sentences.en: Taverns all over celebrated from the early hours.
sentences.zh: 人们争夺观看绞刑的门票，但玛丽·安的家人没有做出任何出席的努力。

sentences.en: People fought for tickets to see the hanging, but Mary Ann's family made no effort to attend.
sentences.zh: 前一天晚上，莱恩哈特一直熬到凌晨5点，与监狱警卫和记者交谈。

sentences.en: The night before, Reinhardt had stayed up until 5am conversing with prison guards and reporters.
sentences.zh: 他看起来很高兴，还跟他们开玩笑，好像这一天不是他的末日一样。

sentences.en: He seemed cheery and joked with them, as if the day was not to be his laSt.
sentences.zh: 那天早晨下着大雨，阻碍了许多狂热的人群前往。

sentences.en: Rain fell hard that morning, deterring many of the maddening crowd from attending.
sentences.zh: 随着时间临近，莱恩哈特虽然生为天主教徒，却拒绝了一位天主教神父的来访，转而接受了一位浸信会牧师陪伴他直到他临终的时刻。

sentences.en: As time drew nearer, Reinhardt, although born Catholic, refused a visit from a Catholic priest, instead accepting a Baptist clergyman to remain with him until his moment of death.
sentences.zh: 牧师站在绞刑架旁，用低沉、缓慢的语调祈祷，而又重又刺骨的冷雨猛烈地打在院子里每一个人身上。

sentences.en: The clergyman stood at the gallows and prayed in hushed, slow tones as the heavy and bitterly cold rain fell hard onto all those in the yard.
sentences.zh: 当爱德华·莱恩哈特被带出来时，头上戴着黑帽，雨水浸透了他，他面无表情地看着人群。

sentences.en: As Edward Reinhardt was brought out with the black cap on his head, the rain drenched him as he looked upon the crowd with barely an expression.
sentences.zh: 随着牧师的祈祷结束，布罩拉下盖住他的脸，他一句话也没说。

sentences.en: He didn't say a word as the prayers of the clergyman came to an end and the cloth was drawn down over his face.
sentences.zh: 他身边的警官和他握了握手，在头套下面可以听到他说再见。

sentences.en: The officers beside him shook his hand and from beneath the cap he could be heard to say goodbye.
sentences.zh: 活板门随即弹开，莱恩哈特下坠了大约四英尺。

sentences.en: Immediately the trap was sprung and Reinhardt dropped down about four feet.
sentences.zh: 他像没有生命一样摇晃了几下，然后试图举起双手。

sentences.en: He swayed a few moments as if lifeless, then tried to raise his hands.
sentences.zh: 他把指甲掐进手掌，挣扎了一小会儿，然后死去了。

sentences.en: He pressed his nails into his palms, struggled a little, and died.
sentences.zh: 他把指甲掐进手掌，挣扎了一小会儿，然后死去了。
